## Analysis

sol_0046 crashed before evaluation, so the proposed multiobjective direction remains completely untested. sol_0045 also exposed a critical reliability failure: despite claiming an immediate 66-point fallback, it emitted the inferior 473-point set. Future solvers must hard-code and verify the exact sol_0036 set before searching, then never overwrite it unless exact enumeration confirms a strict improvement. The long plateau across many single-objective neighborhoods still supports exploring scalarizations that preserve candidates with unfavorable current \(C\) but novel \((n,|A+A|,|A-A|)\) tradeoffs.

## Next

Implement the previously unexecuted Pareto search: 24 replicas on `[0,220]`, `50 <= n <= 90`, with \(\lambda\) evenly spaced over `[1.06,1.18]`, optimizing `log(s/n)-lambda*log(d/n)` via toggles, swaps, and contiguous 2–6-point moves for 145 seconds. Maintain a nondominated archive keyed by `(n,s,d)`, exchange archive states every 2,000 proposals, and atomically replace the verified sol_0036 fallback only when exact true \(C\) improves.
